profile.headline: Software Developer, Jacq of all trades, skilled in web design, development, Wordpress, and custom c# application with a knack for accessibility and cybersecurity
profile.summary:
Software is a gateway to the unimaginable, we can build anything, design the future, all from our standing desks. I enjoy helping others imagine and achieve their goals with websites and software. I have a career history of being a jack of all trades, tell me where you need me and I’ll figure out the rest. Whether it's coding in various languages or diving deep into frameworks, my goal is to create solutions that not only meet but exceed expectations.

I’ve worked as a web designer, web developer, Wordpress developer, figma creator, c# custom applications, barcoding technology and solutions, skilled in GS1 bar-coding skills (ha), and I run the admin for a few active websites. 

Looking for a site, app or need help creating a video tutorial? Visit devmommi.com and request a quote, or shoot me an email: jacq@devmommi.com

Happy coding!

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: Front-End Development · Responsiveness · C (Programming Language)

positions.title: Professional development
positions.description:
Coder Foundry Bootcamp - Educational Gap

Thrived in a fast-paced learning environment utilizing a variety of technical skills and producing three intricate ASP.Net applications written in C# and integrated in Bootstrap, Javascript, HTML, and Postgres as the Database all with an MVC design pattern. Along with a few smaller projects which can be checked out via my portfolio link above.
